hypothesis: Can a tokenless local hypothesis-mismatch weight programming and 4-hypothesis counterfactual-witness intervention selector achieve meaningfully better action-efficient prediction on unseen interventions than a fully fitted Bayesian information-gain selector using the same candidate causal laws and public observations, while consuming fewer whole-process resources?

worlds.law_generator: H candidate two-layer Boolean intervention-consequence mechanisms indexed 0..H-1. For each index, use SHA256('F48/law/v1|index') to assign four input parent slots, four input polarity bits, two hidden gate types (AND/XOR/OR) and final XOR-with-gate/bias output. Each candidate maps every 8-bit do-input intervention to a single downstream outcome bit. Candidate pool, not actual selected law ID, is provided identically to all arms. All candidate functions must be pairwise distinct or reject before first world outcome.
worlds.true_law: One hidden candidate index per (H,seed) selected by SHA256 first8('F48/true/v1|H|seed')%H, passed to scoring evaluator only, never to selectors. This is in-family development, NOT novel/unfamiliar-world transfer.
worlds.public_observation: For a selected intervention 8-bit input a and that action's repeat index k, return one public binary outcome y = true_law(a) XOR Bernoulli(0.10) using SHA256 first8('F48/obs/v1|H|seed|a|k') < floor(2**64/10). Each query costs one action and one binary outcome. Repeated actions cost another query, no oracle labels or privileged test labels.
worlds.prefix_rule: All four arms run 32 observations per world, save irreversible cold checkpoints and score at 8,16,32 query prefixes; report 32,16,8 (largest first). No extra samples or post-result budget changes.
worlds.action_scores: Score MAP hypothesis's predicted outcome on every action never queried by that arm (at least 224 held-out 8-bit interventions per 32-query world); report accuracy, predictive entropy/remaining hypothesis ambiguity and exact-hidden-law identification. Evaluator-only true outcomes do not enter training or action selection.

native_witness.memory: Source-free integer mismatch counter weight for each candidate hypothesis, updated by +1 on each observed incorrect predicted bit; no gradient, transformer, token embeddings or accepted native Yggdrasil weights.
native_witness.policy: At each step choose the four hypotheses with smallest mismatch counts (stable candidate-ID tie break). Choose 8-bit intervention maximizing count of discordant predicted outputs across the 6 candidate pairs; stable lowest action ID tie break. This is an explicit model-vs-model consequential intervention tournament, NOT F46/F47 row-ranking; all predictions come from permitted public candidate pool.
native_witness.readout: MAP hypothesis = minimum mismatch count, stable candidate-ID tie break; use candidate predicted binary consequences on unqueried action set. Integer checkpoint SHA256 protects cold restoration.

bayes_information_gain.memory: Exact Bayesian posterior for independent 10% binary observation flips and uniform prior over same H candidate laws, using the same mismatch counts per hypothesis.
bayes_information_gain.policy: For every 8-bit action, calculate posterior-predictive probability of outcome1 from all H hypotheses. Select the action maximizing binary predictive entropy H_2(p) (equivalently myopic mutual information because conditional noise entropy is constant). Stable lowest action ID tie break. Repeated actions allowed and charged.
bayes_information_gain.readout: MAP hypothesis and same unseen-action accuracy. Do NOT weaken this strong fully fitted model-based conventional active control.

uniform.memory: Identical integer hypothesis mismatch counters and candidate pool.
uniform.policy: Deterministic counterfactual-independent sequence action_t=(73*t)%256, including repeated actions only if necessary. No hidden true labels.

random.memory: Identical integer hypothesis mismatch counters and candidate pool.
random.policy: Independent deterministic random.Random(100003*seed+H) action 0..255 each step. All actions charged.

frozen_metrics.performance: Unseen-action MAP predictive accuracy, heldout action count, hidden law identified, posterior predictive entropy, query count, public outcome bits, candidate law duplication check, complete per-arm full wall time and candidate-action prediction accesses plus memory/checkpoint bytes. Equal actions are necessary but do not establish equal total compute. Native must beat strongest Bayesian IG, not just random or uniform, at b16 to earn DEV_GO.
frozen_metrics.negative_controls: Out-of-domain actions, nonbinary observations and double-booked/out-of-sequence events rejected. Corrupt cold checkpoint rejected. First-use fences verified. A separate cloned model may receive a genuine extra public outcome without mutating the original cold checkpoint; no speculative edits. The hidden candidate chosen only by evaluator.
frozen_metrics.frozen_decision: DEV_COUNTERFACTUAL_WITNESS_GO iff every positive criterion met, otherwise DEV_COUNTERFACTUAL_WITNESS_NO_GO. Original scientific_pass=false regardless of developmental metrics. If no hypothesis prediction uniqueness, fail closed instead of modifying law generator. Do not tune after results.
